concerns_addressed: Backend contract test verifies real Laravel HTTP endpoint response envelope (status, data, meta), supplier nested object, meta.summary shape, meta.categories, status sort priority (Aktif→supplier-ineligible→Nonaktif), category sort (trim alphabetic, null-last, id DESC ties), pagination contract, AND-filtered summary, and legacy eligibility preservation without include_unpurchasable=1.

Frontend page contract test verifies rendered page with real adapter + mocked global fetch: legacy default request params (limit=15, cursor=0, sort=created_at, order=desc, include_unpurchasable=1) present, no new filter params sent by default; identity columns (category with em dash fallback), status precedence (Nonaktif for inactive product overrides expired supplier), stock health (0→Habis, 40→Aman), summary strip from meta.summary; sort=category and sort=status header clicks send correct params with cursor reset; clarity filter params (status, stock_health, category) sent with AND semantics and include_unpurchasable=1 preserved.

Legacy regression guard verifies default id ASC ordering, limit=100 hard page size, has_more=true with 101 total, supplier eligibility excludes non-active/orphan suppliers without include_unpurchasable flag.

All acceptance criteria from spec mapped to test assertions: main table clarity, stock normalization/health, filter contract (AND semantics, invalid ignored, categories from meta), status/category sorting contracts, filtered summary/API contract, legacy defaults preserved.

Mechanical gate verified: apps/api ProductTest 22 passed (236 assertions), apps/api full suite 692 passed/7 skipped, apps/web products tests 4 suites 70 passed, apps/web full suite 74 suites 677 passed, tsc --noEmit exit 0, git diff on Table.tsx and database schema empty.

strengths: Contract tests cross real HTTP/render seams: backend uses Laravel's real getJson endpoint; frontend mocks only global fetch, adapter and page render for real.

Assertions are precise and non-tautological: exact envelope key sets (assertSame on array_keys), exact field sets per row (assertEqualsCanonicalizing), exact supplier shape, exact sort orders with id DESC tie-break, exact filtered totals/summaries.

Fixtures cover all critical edge cases: active/inactive product, active/inactive supplier, null supplier, orphan supplier (supplier_id=999999), null/empty category, zero/negative/fractional stock via backend normalization, history product for id DESC tie-break.
No silent fallback: tests assert sort=category and sort=status are sent on header click, filters send all three params simultaneously with cursor reset.
Scope hygiene perfect: exactly 2 test files modified (352 insertions), no implementation files, no Table.tsx, no database schema, no cross-module files.
Dummy mode boundary intact: T6 tests run in real mode only; existing dummy parity tests pass unchanged.
Clear test naming and section comments explaining each contract dimension being verified.

issues.description: New backend test method test_admin_product_list_matches_frontend_clarity_contract_across_filters_sorts_and_legacy_eligibility is ~157 lines (exceeds ~50-line heuristic). This is a feature-test convention in the codebase (pre-existing tests also exceed 50 lines: test_category_and_status_sort_contracts at 88 lines, test_no_category_sentinel at 62 lines). The test is well-structured with clear comment-delimited sections for each contract dimension.

Both test files exceed 300 lines (ProductTest.php 871 lines, page.test.tsx ~1199 lines) — pre-existing state (656/1062 before T6). Large feature test classes are the established convention for this codebase (T4 review accepted 320-line page.tsx within sibling convention).
